response.sql: WITH q AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_count FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId), avg_q AS (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers) AS avg_count) SELECT q.driverId, q.qualifying_count, q.qualifying_count / avg_q.avg_count AS ratio FROM q CROSS JOIN avg_q ORDER BY ratio DESC, q.driverId LIMIT 10;
